recorded.outcome:q-first-pass:b: The gate runs on a `Portfolio`, so it runs only after the cells are clean (snapshot(): `if pf is None: raise Rejected(found)` comes before `found += gate(pf)`)
recorded.prompt:q-first-pass:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-first-pass:d: the reader reports every cell problem in one pass; the reader 'records a finding ... instead of raising'
recorded.prompt:q-sound-rule:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-sound-rule:b: Code takes `min(p.spend(t).get(y, 0) for t in p.starts())`, which is 0 for 2030 when the project can start in 2031; the rule concerns 'a year whose budget is below what must-do work has to spend in it whatever start years it gets'
recorded.prompt:q-sound-rule:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-sound-rule:c: The finding is raised only `if least > pf.budget[y]`; with the 2031 start, least for 2030 is 0, so the rule reports nothing, warning or otherwise ('it never refuses a portfolio that has a plan')
